verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official first-party MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API (docs-44, probe-4). That lets an AI-native user drive Stripe through natural language from an agent client. However, the evidence never shows these tools covering the crypto and stablecoin features, and there is no native natural-language interface in the product itself. Machine payments (agents paying for services) and llms.txt are different capabilities and are not credited here. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface, evidence that the MCP tools cover stablecoin payments, payouts, onramp and treasury operations, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
